title: The Jump Rope with Room in the Middle
youtube_title: The Jump Rope with Room in the Middle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Jorie sees that a jump rope with room for a middle turn will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Jorie makes a smaller, even share so Ines is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
